house-of-blues-boston.name: House of Blues Boston
house-of-blues-boston.capacity_text: Capacity per House of Blues capacity breakdown: Music Hall standing/reception about 1,800 to 2,000 (seated theater about 315 to 350). Room for this show not confirmed. Floor area not provided, so exit density is not estimated. Rated Low; confirm the room and times with the venue.

shubert-theatre.name: Shubert Theatre
shubert-theatre.capacity_text: Total seating about 1,500 to 1,600 (orchestra, mezzanine, balcony, and box seats). Seated audience, so standing density is not expected. Mezzanine is reached by stairs only, with no elevator, which can slow exits for some attendees. Rated Low; confirm the seating and times with the venue.

somerville-theatre.name: Somerville Theatre
somerville-theatre.capacity_text: Main theatre about 840 seats (815 for general admission shows; up to 900 in some listings): orchestra 379, balcony and mezzanine 461. Crystal Ballroom in the same building holds 500 standing or about 230 to 240 at cabaret tables. Room for this show not confirmed. Seated audience, so standing density is not expected. Rated Low; confirm the room and times with the venue.
